Meta’s AI-powered Search Bar: Latest Update on Instagram

29 April 2024·Impulse Digital

Have you noticed a new feature on your Instagram recently? Yes, here we are talking about the integration of an AI-driven search bar on Instagram. This feature specifically takes incorporating AI to the next level and is in the testing phase. It incorporates Meta’s search feature through the Llama 3 model, which generates AI’s search by Google and Bing on your Instagram itself.  

The existence of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has undoubtedly emerged and drawn its visibility in various fields serving its well-defined purpose in every way.  

In preceding times, the use of AI has only kept growing, and hence, the human dependence on AI has increased in day-to-day functioning. The massive popularity of social media applications has become a reason to empower it, with the latest updates and next-generation functions. One such is the latest Meta’s AI search update by Llama model.  

On the other hand, Instagram’s popularity and active user number are highest in India, at approximately 358.55 million. In addition to this, it became necessary for people to have easy access to AI features.
